identity_anchors: stylized bird head profile facing right
circular body silhouette with ear-like tuft at top-left
white negative-space eye with red pupil
purple microphone held in lower-right quadrant
must_preserve: bird head orientation and ear tuft position
eye as white negative space with centered red dot pupil
microphone shape, placement, and purple color
overall circular form factor with smooth rounded edges
gradient direction: warm top (orange) to cool bottom (pink)
can_restyle: gradient saturation or hue shift within brand palette
microphone handle thickness or slight angle adjustment
edge softness or inner glow effects
background opacity or subtle texture overlay
pupil size relative to eye cavity (within recognizability limits)
must_not_replace_with: abstract shapes lacking bird + mic combination
color_preservation: Retain orange-to-pink vertical gradient as primary brand identifier; purple microphone must remain distinct and unsaturated away from body gradient. Eye white and pupil red are non-negotiable for recognition.
structure_summary: Circular bird-head silhouette with top-left ear tuft, white negative-space eye containing red pupil, and purple microphone emerging from lower-right. Gradient flows vertically from orange to pink. All elements fused into single cohesive glyph.
risk_notes: Flattening gradient loses brand warmth signature
Rotating bird head disrupts user muscle memory
Replacing eye with solid shape eliminates negative-space identity
Using uniform color across body erases top-bottom thermal metaphor
